items.why: Two searches, different phrasings. Both returned substantial ADJACENT literature -- Bunke-Nikolaus-Tamme on the Beilinson regulator as a map of ring spectra, polylogarithmic motivic complexes, the Eisenstein symbol, Bunke-Tamme on differential algebraic K-theory -- and abundant J_3(O) literature separately (F_4 as its automorphism group, the cubic norm, the particle-physics uses). THE COMBINATION IS ABSENT. The searches work; the connection is not there. cc typed this correctly.

The state-integral literature is rich and covers SL(2,C) AND SL(n,C) for general n -- DGG, Andersen-Kashaev, the level-k construction, the non-perturbative state-integral model on ideal triangulations. Exceptional groups are absent. SO THE GAP IS NOT 'no state integrals' BUT 'nobody has gone past the SL(n) SERIES'. That is a sharper statement than NEEDS-SPECIALIST and it names what would be required: an extension of the DGG/Andersen-Kashaev construction beyond the classical series.
